findings.title: NEW first-party physics source found (upgrade over the idea study)
findings.text: NASA's own image article states: *"Chiao's picture is upside down because light is refracted, or bent, as it passes from one medium to another – in this case, air to water."* [2](https://www.nasa.gov/image-article/bubbly-chiao/) The idea study leaned on third-party reporting for this mechanism; ab isko official NASA wording se anchor kiya gaya hai. Surface tension / curved-liquid optics bhi NASA se [3](https://www.nasa.gov/science-research/astrophysics/what-is-the-fluidic-telescope/).

findings.title: Replay-first structure is evidence-backed
findings.text: YouTube Help defines spikes as moments viewers rewatched or shared [6](https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/9314415?hl=en); har chapter ek replay pass hai. Ye koi algorithm trick ka dawa nahi.

findings.title: BLOCKER: 16:9 ke liye source abhi vertical hai
findings.text: Local master `1080x1920` vertical hai [8](workspace://production/monarch-cam/caught_on_camera_commentary_v10/review/final/rights_ledger_v10.json), jabke target 16:9 landscape hai [11](workspace://research/long_form_viral_idea_v11/LONG_FORM_VIRAL_IDEA_FORENSIC_STUDY_V11.md). Original 4K `3840x2160` file (SHA 7fd9cd0cfc22…) workspace me **present nahi** hai — sirf ledger me record hai [8](workspace://production/monarch-cam/caught_on_camera_commentary_v10/review/final/rights_ledger_v10.json). Isliye Phase D shuru hone se pehle original 4K re-fetch ya human-approved crop/pillarbox plan chahiye. Maine koi upscale/crop invent nahi kiya.

findings.title: BLOCKER: render/QC toolchain is session me maujood nahi
findings.text: System ffmpeg/ffprobe aur numpy available nahi, bundled `v10_deps` bhi is snapshot me nahi. Isliye **abhi koi render, VO synthesis ya QC nahi chalaya** — ye honest tooling gap hai, koi failure chhupaya nahi gaya.

findings.title: GATE: rights / monetization abhi OPEN
findings.text: NASA promotional-content gate khula hai [5](https://www.nasa.gov/collaborating-with-nasa/strategic-partnerships/) [4](https://www.nasa.gov/nasa-brand-center/images-and-media/), `human_legal_review=false`, `commercial_monetization_clearance=false` [8](workspace://production/monarch-cam/caught_on_camera_commentary_v10/review/final/rights_ledger_v10.json), aur user ne Short ka monetization ON bataya hai [13](workspace://research/long_form_viral_idea_v11/MONETIZATION_ON_IMMEDIATE_ACTION_V11.md). Long-form ko **monetized / promotional publish** tab tak nahi jaana chahiye. Script/audit ka kaam is gate ko close nahi karta [12](workspace://research/long_form_viral_idea_v11/UPLOAD_SAFETY_V11.md).

blockers: 16:9 source: local master is 1080x1920; original 4K not present locally
render/QC toolchain absent in this snapshot (ffmpeg/ffprobe/numpy/v10_deps)
open_gates: NASA promotional content / identifiable current astronauts
user-reported Short monetization ON, not agent-verified
guardrails: One NASA clip only; credit 'Source: NASA / Artemis II' + 'no endorsement implied' [4](https://www.nasa.gov/nasa-brand-center/images-and-media/).
No 'No CGI', '100% real', AI-free claim, invented date, injury, outcome or view-count claim.
No 'official NASA', NASA insignia, co-branding, astronaut names used promotionally [5](https://www.nasa.gov/collaborating-with-nasa/strategic-partnerships/).

VO must never say 'according to NASA' or imply NASA reviewed/approved this analysis - NASA SI guidance prohibits that form of attribution [4](https://www.nasa.gov/nasa-brand-center/images-and-media/). Factual source disclosure ('Source: NASA / Artemis II') is retained instead.
NASA native audio retained; no music, SFX, procedural bed, audio substitution or time-stretch [9](workspace://production/monarch-cam/caught_on_camera_commentary_v10/review/final/qc_summary.json).
No stock b-roll as hero, no reaction-only footage, no clickbait without payoff [14](workspace://config/channels.json).
No unrelated/misleading tags, engagement coercion, guaranteed virality/retention/views/RPM.
AI-use toggle, visibility, audience and license are human decisions [7](https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/14328491?hl=en).
technical_pass stays separate from human_creative_approval / human_legal_review (both false) [9](workspace://production/monarch-cam/caught_on_camera_commentary_v10/review/final/qc_summary.json).
